reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the finding correctly proposes no redline and no counterparty comment, matching expectations for a compliant classification.

The cited text supports the preferred position: Section 12.3 gives AbbVie (our party) termination for convenience on 90 days' notice with no termination fee or accelerated payment, and Section 12.9 preserves ordinary law/equity remedies rather than fixing a stipulated sum.

Section 6.10 late-payment interest is mutual and compensatory, correctly characterized as not a Customer-payable penalty or liquidated damages; milestone/royalty obligations are consideration, not LDs.
No deterministic check failures and the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs, consistent with a no-edit compliant finding.
